evals.prompt: I need a Magento 2 module called Acme_StockAlert that logs a warning whenever a product is saved with quantity 0. We're on Mage-OS 2.4.9. Put it in app/code and make sure it actually compiles.
evals.expected_output: A module with registration.php, etc/module.xml, composer.json, an observer on catalog_product_save_after (or an after-plugin on ProductRepositoryInterface::save) checking stock qty, constructor-injected LoggerInterface, no ObjectManager usage, passes setup:di:compile and phpcs --standard=Magento2 with docblocks.
assertions: registration.php, etc/module.xml, and composer.json exist with consistent Acme_StockAlert naming
Uses an observer (events.xml) or plugin (di.xml), NOT a class preference/rewrite
No ObjectManager::getInstance() anywhere in the generated code
bin/magento setup:di:compile passes with the module enabled
All classes and public methods have PHPDoc blocks (phpcs Magento2 warning-free)

evals.prompt: How do I change the price that Magento returns for products in a specific customer group? I was going to override Magento\Catalog\Model\Product with my own class via di.xml preference - is that right?
evals.expected_output: Advice steering away from a preference: explain preference conflicts, recommend an after-plugin on the price-related public method or the catalog price hooks, with concrete di.xml + plugin class code.
assertions: Explicitly advises AGAINST the preference/rewrite approach and explains why (conflicts, composition)
Recommends a plugin (or dedicated pricing extension point), with working di.xml and plugin class code
Mentions area scoping or sortOrder considerations for the plugin

evals.prompt: My Magento layout XML changes aren't showing up on the product page. I added view/frontend/layout/catalog_product_view.xml to my module with a new block but nothing renders. The module is enabled.
evals.expected_output: A systematic debugging walkthrough: clean layout/full_page caches, verify handle name, check area directory, check theme overrides, validate XML against schema, check system.log for invalid template warnings, optionally enable template hints.
assertions: Tells the user to clean the layout/full_page/block_html caches as an early step
Mentions checking the template path (Vendor_Module::path resolution) or system.log for invalid template/XML warnings
Mentions at least one of: theme override precedence, template hints, or validating the XML schema
